target_customer: Businesses with variable demand, such as retail and hospitality operators, that schedule staff and resources
problem: Businesses are over or under staffed because they lack granular, accurate demand forecasts.
business_model: Demand forecasting as a service (pricing not stated)

founders.name: Rishi Raman
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no employers or education.

competitors.name: Legion
competitors.what: AI workforce scheduling with demand forecasting for hourly businesses
competitors.funding_then: Raised a $22M Series B in Sep 2020

competitors.name: PredictHQ
competitors.what: Demand intelligence mapping real world events to demand, used for workforce optimization
competitors.funding_then: Raised a $22M Series B in Feb 2020 per search summary

technical_complexity.rationale: Forecasting models are well understood but accuracy across many customers' messy data is hard for a team of four.

defensibility.rationale: Open source forecasting libraries and funded scheduling vendors with forecasting built in made the service replicable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source describes incumbent action against Intelligent.

market_need_then: The YC description cites staffing mismatch as a cost for businesses; pandemic demand swings in 2020 made forecasting more valuable but no figures were found.

branding.domain_note: Site was intelligent.services, a .services domain rather than a .com; fetch returned 503.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic adjective as a name; searches for the brand return only unrelated consulting pages and no press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: YC marks Intelligent inactive. No shutdown notice, acquisition or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public. The company competed against funded scheduling platforms that bundled forecasting, and it had a very small team, but no source confirms why it stopped.
notes: Company site returned HTTP 503 so it was treated as unreachable. Funding search found only a Latka estimate and a Quill pre-seed figure that belongs to a different company, neither recorded. The PredictHQ date comes from the search summary text, not an opened page.
